description: Texture of ORNAMENTAL BURSTS attached to a composed LINE: the notedata file carries both the input sound's assumed MIDI pitch AND a notelist melody; the engine repeats that line every 'skiptime' seconds and hangs a random decoration-group (gpsizlo-gpsizhi events, gppaklo-gppakhi ms apart, spanning gpranglo-gpranghi semitones, amprise/contour-shaped, centring-positioned around the line pitch) on its notes. Pinned to submode 5 ('NONE' - free decoration pitch; submodes 1-4 lock decorations to harmonic fields/sets). NOTEDATA (probe-pinned error surface, all verbatim): line 1 = assumed pitch of each input sound; then '#N' and N rows of 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' - the decorated line. Missing notelist: 'Incorrect number [0] of motifs in notedata file (expected 1).'; missing '#': "'#' missing before datacount in notedata file: motif 1 (or more notes listed than indicated by #N)"; short count: 'Note data line for note 2, motif 1 missing in notedatafile'; reversed times: 'Notes in reverse time order: notedata file : motif 1: notes 2 & 1'. A line starting after t=0 is legal. Genuinely stochastic with a WORKING -r seed (-r5 twice 1.3 s apart byte-identical; -r9 differs; unseeded and -r0 differ run to run - 0 is the clock). BANNER DIVERGENCES (first-class): centring is enforced 0-6 ('Parameter[21] ... out of range (0.000000 to 6.000000)') though this banner claims 0-7; pos (-p) is enforced 0-1 ('Parameter[23] ... out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)') though the banner claims '-1(Left) 1(Right)'. contour here allows 0-8 (values 7-8 are the decorated-family extras; grouped stops at 6). SKIPTIME 0 HANGS the binary (exit only by timeout; range floor 0.000002 not applied to a literal 0). Breakpoints: every numeric positional accepted a brk file EXCEPT outdur, gpspace, contour and centring (refusals verbatim: 'Cannot read parameter 1/14/17/26'); flags -a/-p/-s brk-capable, seed refused (parameter 30). Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' on stereo); output always STEREO. Option flags are ORDER-ENFORCED (-a -p -s -r then switches: '-r5 -a0.5' refuses 'option flag -a out of order on cmdline.').
musical_use: Where texture simple scatters dots and grouped throws unpitched flurries, DECORATED is compositional: you write a melody (the notedata notelist) and the engine embellishes it - grace-note clusters, mordent-like flickers, arpeggiated halos around each line note, re-stated every skiptime like a varied ostinato. Keep the line short (one to four notes) and let skiptime set the phrase period; gpsizlo/hi and gppaklo/hi shape each ornament's density and speed (2-5 events at 20-80 ms reads as baroque decoration, 10+ at short paks as granular fizz); gpranglo/hi sets how far ornaments roam from the line pitch and centring whether they sit on, above or below it (0-6). contour/amprise give each ornament its dynamic arc, including the decorated-only 7/8 'directed to event' shapes. Use -k to keep only the ornaments (the line becomes a ghost armature), -w to let every event ring the whole source, -d for evenly-spaced ornament notes. Time-varying skiptime accelerates the phrase cycle; time-varying gpsize/gppak evolve ornament complexity across the render. Always set a seed to pin a take. Sits between texture grouped (no line) and the ornate/motifs family (fully specified ornament shapes, execute()).

notedata.description: REQUIRED text file (write with write_data_file()): line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of each input sound (single value here); then '#N' and N notelist rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' (times non-decreasing; infile_no 1 with one input; amp is MIDI-style 1-127; dur in seconds) - the line the ornaments decorate. All format refusals are verbatim in the entry description. Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

outdur.description: Requested duration. Actual output overshoots by roughly the line length plus the last ornament's tail (+0.6-0.75 s on a 0.2 s one-note line with small groups: 5 -> 5.71, 8 -> 8.60, 3 -> 3.74) - keep line+ornament small relative to outdur when length matters. Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

skiptime.description: Time between repetitions of the decorated line - the phrase period (CDP-enforced 0.000002 to 100: 'Parameter[3] Value (-1.000000) out of range (0.000002 to 100.000000)'). LANDMINE: a literal 0 slips the range check and HANGS the binary (timeout-killed) - keep it positive. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0 verified).

sndfirst.description: First sound to use from the input list (single-input entry: must be 1; 2 refused 'FIRST SND-IN-LIST TO USE > count of files entered: cannot proceed.'). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

sndlast.description: Last sound to use from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

maxdur.description: Maximum event duration (>= mindur; values far beyond the input duration fail obscurely - family finding). Contributes to the duration overshoot. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

phgrid.description: Timegrid in ms applying WITHIN decorations (0 = none). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gpspace.description: Spatialisation of decoration-groups, CDP-enforced 0-5 ('Parameter[11] Value (6.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 5.000000)'): 0 still, 1 scattered (default), 2 towards centre, 3 away, 4/5 follow/counter texture motion. Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 14 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.') - same manual divergence as texture grouped.

amprise.description: Amplitude change within each decoration, CDP-enforced 0-127 ('Parameter[13] Value (128.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 127.000000)'; default 0 = flat). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

contour.description: Amplitude contour of decorations, CDP-enforced 0-8 ('Parameter[14] Value (9.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 8.000000)'): 0 mixed, 1 cresc, 2 flat, 3 decresc, 4-6 combinations, 7 directed_to_event, 8 dir_or_flat (7-8 are decorated-family extras; grouped stops at 6). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 17').

gpsizlo.description: Smallest number of events in a decoration. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gpsizhi.description: Largest number of events in a decoration - with gppakhi this bounds the ornament tail past outdur (family warning: large values inflate the render). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gppaklo.description: Shortest time between event onsets within a decoration, ms (family floor = one sample period, srate-dependent). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gppakhi.description: Longest time between event onsets within a decoration, ms. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gpranglo.description: Minimum pitch range of decorations in semitones (mode 5; hfield-note counts in modes 1-4). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gpranghi.description: Maximum pitch range of decorations in semitones. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

centring.description: How decoration pitches centre on the line pitch, ENFORCED 0-6 ('Parameter[21] Value (8.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 6.000000)' - the banner's 'Range 0-7' is WRONG): 0 centred, 1 above, 2 below, 3-6 combinations. Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 26').

atten.description: Overall attenuation multiplier, CDP-enforced 0.000002-1 ('Parameter[22] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.000002 to 1.000000)'). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0). Flag order enforced: -a before -p -s -r.

position.description: Centre of the stereo image - ENFORCED 0-1 ('Parameter[23] Value (-1.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)'; the banner's '-1(Left) 1(Right): default 0' is WRONG on both range and default). Breakpoint-capable (verified with an in-range 0.1->0.9 ramp after an out-of-range brk value refused).

spread.description: Spatial spread of texture events 0-1 ('Parameter[24]' refusal verbatim). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

seed.description: Random seed - WORKING (-r5 twice 1.3 s apart byte-identical in decoded samples AND frame count; -r5 vs -r9 differ). 0 (or omission) seeds from the clock (-r0 runs all differ). Family range 0-32767. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 30').

whole.description: Play the whole input per event, ignoring mindur/maxdur (verified: changes render, +0.18 s tail on the probe settings).

fixstep.description: Fixed timestep between decoration notes instead of random gppaklo-gppakhi (verified: changes render).

instrvary.description: Instruments vary within decorations - meaningful only with multiple input sounds (verified byte-identical no-op on this single-input entry).

dectop.description: Decorate the TOP note of line chords instead of the first listed (verified byte-identical no-op when the line has no chords).

decall.description: Decorate ALL notes of line chords (verified byte-identical no-op without chords).

discardline.description: Discard the original line after decoration - ornaments only (verified: changes render, same length).

examples.description: Ornamented two-note ostinato: quick 2-5 event decorations on a repeating line.
examples.expected_use:
First write_data_file('ndec.txt', '60
#2
0 1 60 64 0.5
1 1 62 64 0.5'). The two-note line restates every 1.5 s, each note haloed by a 2-5 event ornament roaming 3-8 st; rerun with seed 5 for the identical take.

examples.description: Ornaments only (line discarded), decorations pushed above the line pitch.
examples.expected_use: A stream of rising, crescendoing flickers hung on an invisible melody - the ghost-armature trick.

known_issues: Duration honesty (set_by outdur): actual overshoots by about the line length plus the last decoration's tail - +14% (5 -> 5.71), +7.5% (8 -> 8.60), +25% (3 -> 3.74) on a 0.2 s one-note line at skiptime 0.5 with small groups; larger lines/groups overshoot more (a 2-note 1.5 s line at skiptime 1.5 hit +26% on outdur 5). duration_row uses tol 0.2 with the small-line settings; keep line+ornament small relative to outdur when length matters.
SKIPTIME 0 HANGS the binary (accepted past the 0.000002 floor, then never terminates - timeout is the only guard). The curated minimum is the CDP floor; never map 0 through.

BANNER ERRORS (binary-enforced values win): centring 0-6, not the banner's 0-7; position (-p) 0-1 with CDP default 0.5, not the banner's -1..1 default 0. contour is genuinely 0-8 here (decorated-family extras 7/8).

Breakpoint surface (all probed): outdur, gpspace, contour, centring and seed REFUSE brk files (parameters 1/14/17/26/30 verbatim); every other numeric positional plus -a/-p/-s accepts one (exit 0). Same gpspace/contour manual divergence as texture grouped.
Option flags are ORDER-ENFORCED: -a -p -s -r then switches ('option flag -a out of order on cmdline.' verbatim). The entry declares them in banner order for build_cdp_argv.
Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output is always STEREO. Genuinely stochastic with a working -r seed; -r0 and omission are the clock path.

-i/-h/-e are content-dependent no-ops here (single input, chord-free line - each verified byte-identical); they go live with multiple inputs / chordal lines via execute(). Notedata error surface quoted verbatim in the description.

RETRY NOTE: planned in Phase 5 wave 2 but never probed (no drop record exists in tranche 5-7 docs); this curation is the first landing. Modes 1-4 (harmonic-field decorations) and predecor/postdecor remain execute()-only.
